segments.name: TiO 2 segment
segments.description: Produces and sells titanium dioxide pigments and related by-products to paint, plastics, decorative laminate and paper manufacturers and other customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: Sales of our core TiO 2 pigments represented approximately 90% of our net sales in 2025.

revenueModel.text: Paint, plastics, decorative laminate and paper manufacturers, and other industrial customers, pay the company and its distributors and agents for titanium dioxide pigments and technical services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our major customers include domestic and international paint, plastics, decorative laminate and paper manufacturers.
